answer.book: Single treatise, Paulus Voet's De duellis licitis & illicitis, in the 1658 volume 'De duellis ex omni jure casibus liber singularis': an address to the reader and a chapter index, then 35 chapters (I–XXXV), then three juridical disputations De sicariis (Prima–Tertia).
